title: Remove this cooperative channel by exactly disconnecting spectators
statement: For the declared density couplers,an inactive module with exactly zero memory-bath coupling has conserved memory occupation and remains in its empty bath. Conditional spectator occupations shift the active memory frequency by sum_j lambda_ij m_j. This removes the second emitter of the specified cooperative channel if the shifted active gap remains open.

requires: Density-only interunit couplers;exactly zero spectator bath coupling
Empty spectator bath and an actual shifted active-unit gap
provides: Exact conditional spectral reduction to one active emitter
Explicit route for changing the obstruction rather than ignoring it
assumptions: One active module at a time
Imperfect switch-off,exchange couplers and full non-RWA thresholds are not covered
costs: Serial schedule and controllable exact switch-off
Account for all conditional shifts and phases
contract.units: hbar=B=1,source-local energy/time and stated amplitude versus population conventions; no automatic device-unit conversion
contract.obstruction: Not protected arbitrary parallel computation or a cost-free repair.

evidence.range_scope: Exact conserved-spectator reduction,shift condition and scheduling costs.
Completed owner commutator,frequency-separation and comparator review.

body: Actual complete source argument and scoped review govern this unit. No physical input,program execution,priority or advantage is acquired by extraction.
